# Vassalization Extended 0.2.0. Edit the generator/helpers, not this generated file.

# default: generated by tools/build_profiles.py from pinned vanilla.
vassalization_cb = {
	icon = vassalization
	group = vassalization
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes

	attacker_score_from_occupation_scale = 150
	attacker_score_from_battles_scale = 150
	defender_score_from_battles_scale = 150

	allowed_for_character = {
		OR = {
			is_guelph_or_ghibelline_trigger = yes
			has_perk = forced_vassalage_perk
			any_character_struggle = {
				involvement = involved
				has_struggle_phase_parameter = unlocks_forced_vassalization_casus_belli
			}
			AND = {
				OR = {
					has_game_rule = default_conquerors_bonuses
					has_game_rule = extreme_conquerors_bonuses
					has_game_rule = random_conquerors_bonuses
					has_game_rule = reduced_random_conquerors_bonuses
				}
				has_variable = conqueror
			}
			ai_should_get_conqueror_bonuses = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer
			government_has_flag = government_is_merchant
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_republic }
			ai_should_get_conqueror_bonuses = yes
		}
	}

	# Root is the title
	# scope:attacker is the attacker
	# scope:defender is the defender

	allowed_against_character_display_regardless = {
		# Vassalization Extended: no target county cap.
		scope:attacker = { is_landed = yes }
		tgp_japan_offensive_wars_ban_trigger = yes
	}

	allowed_against_character = {
		scope:attacker.highest_held_title_tier > scope:defender.highest_held_title_tier # Must be lower tier
		scope:attacker = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_guelph_or_ghibelline_trigger = yes }
				gg_first_and_second_are_opposite_sides_trigger = { FIRST = scope:attacker SECOND = scope:defender }
			}
		}
		scope:defender = {
			top_liege = this
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:attacker = { is_ai = no } } # Already pre-filtered by the AI due to ai_only_against_neighbors = yes. any_neighboring_top_liege_realm_owner is expensive
				scope:attacker = {
					any_neighboring_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:defender }
				}
			}

			trigger_if = { # if unlocked without the perk, only target involved or interloper
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						scope:attacker = { has_perk = forced_vassalage_perk }
						scope:attacker = { ai_should_get_conqueror_bonuses = yes }
					}
					is_guelph_or_ghibelline_trigger = no
				}
				any_character_struggle = {
					involvement = involved
				}
			}

			NOR = { # Can't vassalize Military Orders or Heads of Faith
				any_held_title = {
					is_holy_order = yes
				}
				AND = {
					exists = faith.religious_head
					faith.religious_head = root
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				desc = CB_SIZE_OF_TARGET_REALM_COST
				scope:defender = {
					every_sub_realm_county = {
						add = {
							value = 125
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = vassalization_cb_prestige_cost_mulitiplier

			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
			multiply = { value = 1 desc = ve_default_cost_factor }
		}
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		OR = {
			scope:defender = {
				top_liege != this
			}
			scope:defender.primary_title.tier >= scope:attacker.primary_title.tier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = {
		on_declared_war = yes
		ve_record_vassalization_terms_effect = { PROFILE = default REFUSAL_RISK = yes }
	}

	on_invalidated_desc = msg_vassalization_war_invalidated_message

	on_invalidated = {}

	on_victory_desc = {
		desc = ve_default_victory_desc
	}

	on_victory = {
		on_victory_aggressive_war_effect = yes

		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = swear_fealty
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = no
		}
		scope:defender = {
			change_liege = {
				liege = scope:attacker
				change = scope:change
			}
			resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		}
		ve_apply_vassalization_terms_effect = { TAX_LEVEL = 2 LEVY_LEVEL = 2 RELIGIOUS_PROTECTION = no }

		# Prestige level progress for the attacker
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige_experience = {
				value = medium_prestige_value
			}
		}

		# Prestige loss for the defender
		scope:defender = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = medium_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
			#GG flips the loser from opposing side to Undecided
			if = {
				limit = {
					gg_first_and_second_are_opposite_sides_trigger = { FIRST = scope:attacker SECOND = scope:defender }
				}
				gg_swap_to_undecided_forced_effect = { USE_MODIFIERS = flag:yes }
			}	
		}

		# Allies on both sides get full prestige value for helping in the war, based on their war participation.
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker
			FAME_BASE = major_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}

		#Guelphs & Ghibellines: gain Involvement based on war contribution
		gg_involvement_cb_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = vassalization_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = vassalization_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}

	on_white_peace = {
		on_white_peace_effect = yes

		#EP2 accolade glory gain for doing ok against higher ranked enemy
		scope:defender = { accolade_defender_war_end_glory_gain_low_effect = yes }

		# Prestige loss for the attacker
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = minor_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}

		# Allies on both sides get full prestige value for helping in the war, based on their war participation.
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker # Not important as the scales are identical
			FAME_BASE = minor_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}

		#Guelphs & Ghibellines: gain Involvement based on war contribution
		gg_involvement_cb_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		desc = ve_default_defeat_desc
	}

	on_defeat = {
		on_defeat_aggressive_war_effect = yes

		scope:defender = {
			#EP2 accolade glory gain for winning against higher ranked enemy
			accolade_defender_war_end_glory_gain_high_effect = yes
			# Prestige for Defender
			add_prestige_war_defender_effect = {
				PRESTIGE_VALUE = medium_prestige_value
			}
		}

		# Prestige loss for the attacker
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = {
				GOLD_VALUE = 3
			}
			add_prestige = {
				value = major_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}

		# Allies on both sides get full prestige value for helping in the war, based on their war participation.
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:defender
			FAME_BASE = major_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}
		ve_apply_refusal_devotion_penalty_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit

	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "ve_default_war_name"
	war_name_base = "ve_default_war_name_base"
	cb_name = "ve_default_cb_name"
	interface_priority = 59

	ticking_war_score_targets_entire_realm = yes
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150
	attacker_ticking_warscore = 0
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8

	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	ai_score_mult = {
		value = 1

		add = common_cb_ai_score_mult_additive
		multiply = aggressive_cb_ai_score_mult
		multiply = vassalization_cb_ai_score_mult
		multiply = common_cb_ai_score_mult
		multiply = ve_default_ai_weight
	}
}

		# Prestige loss for the attacker

			}
			multiply = vassalization_cb_prestige_cost_mulitiplier

			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
			multiply = { value = 1.5 desc = ve_high_cost_factor }
		}
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		OR = {
			scope:defender = { ve_uses_feudal_obligations_trigger = no }

			add_claim_on_loss = no
		}
		scope:defender = {
			change_liege = {
				liege = scope:attacker
				change = scope:change
			}
			resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		}
		ve_apply_vassalization_terms_effect = { TAX_LEVEL = 3 LEVY_LEVEL = 3 RELIGIOUS_PROTECTION = no }

		# Prestige level progress for the attacker
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige_experience = {
				value = medium_prestige_value
			}
		}

		# Prestige loss for the defender
		scope:defender = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = medium_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
			#GG flips the loser from opposing side to Undecided
			if = {
				limit = {
					gg_first_and_second_are_opposite_sides_trigger = { FIRST = scope:attacker SECOND = scope:defender }
				}
				gg_swap_to_undecided_forced_effect = { USE_MODIFIERS = flag:yes }
			}	
		}

		# Allies on both sides get full prestige value for helping in the war, based on their war participation.
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker
			FAME_BASE = major_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}

		#Guelphs & Ghibellines: gain Involvement based on war contribution
		gg_involvement_cb_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = vassalization_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = vassalization_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}

	on_white_peace = {
		on_white_peace_effect = yes

		#EP2 accolade glory gain for doing ok against higher ranked enemy
		scope:defender = { accolade_defender_war_end_glory_gain_low_effect = yes }

		# Prestige loss for the attacker
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = minor_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}

		# Allies on both sides get full prestige value for helping in the war, based on their war participation.
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker # Not important as the scales are identical
			FAME_BASE = minor_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}

		#Guelphs & Ghibellines: gain Involvement based on war contribution
		gg_involvement_cb_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		desc = ve_high_defeat_desc
	}

	on_defeat = {
		on_defeat_aggressive_war_effect = yes

		scope:defender = {
			#EP2 accolade glory gain for winning against higher ranked enemy
			accolade_defender_war_end_glory_gain_high_effect = yes
			# Prestige for Defender
			add_prestige_war_defender_effect = {
				PRESTIGE_VALUE = medium_prestige_value
			}
		}

		# Prestige loss for the attacker
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = {
				GOLD_VALUE = 4.5
			}
			add_prestige = {
				value = major_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}

		# Allies on both sides get full prestige value for helping in the war, based on their war participation.
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:defender
			FAME_BASE = major_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}
		ve_apply_refusal_devotion_penalty_effect = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit

	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "ve_high_war_name"
	war_name_base = "ve_high_war_name_base"
	cb_name = "ve_high_cb_name"
	interface_priority = 59

	ticking_war_score_targets_entire_realm = yes
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150
	attacker_ticking_warscore = 0
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8

	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	ai_score_mult = {
		value = 1

		add = common_cb_ai_score_mult_additive
		multiply = aggressive_cb_ai_score_mult
		multiply = vassalization_cb_ai_score_mult
		multiply = common_cb_ai_score_mult
		multiply = ve_high_ai_weight
	}
}

# religious: generated by tools/build_profiles.py from pinned vanilla.
ve_vassalization_religious_cb = {
	icon = vassalization
	group = vassalization
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes

	attacker_score_from_occupation_scale = 150
	attacker_score_from_battles_scale = 150
	defender_score_from_battles_scale = 150

	allowed_for_character = {
		OR = {
			is_guelph_or_ghibelline_trigger = yes
			has_perk = forced_vassalage_perk
			any_character_struggle = {
				involvement = involved
				has_struggle_phase_parameter = unlocks_forced_vassalization_casus_belli
			}
			AND = {
				OR = {
					has_game_rule = default_conquerors_bonuses
					has_game_rule = extreme_conquerors_bonuses
					has_game_rule = random_conquerors_bonuses
					has_game_rule = reduced_random_conquerors_bonuses
				}
				has_variable = conqueror
			}
			ai_should_get_conqueror_bonuses = yes
		}
		NOR = {
			government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer
			government_has_flag = government_is_merchant
		}
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { government_has_flag = government_is_republic }
			ai_should_get_conqueror_bonuses = yes
		}
	}

	# Root is the title
	# scope:attacker is the attacker
	# scope:defender is the defender

	allowed_against_character_display_regardless = {
		# Vassalization Extended: no target county cap.
		scope:attacker = { is_landed = yes }
		tgp_japan_offensive_wars_ban_trigger = yes
		custom_description = {
			text = ve_religious_protection_available_tt
			ve_religious_protection_available_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	allowed_against_character = {
		scope:attacker.highest_held_title_tier > scope:defender.highest_held_title_tier # Must be lower tier
		scope:attacker = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_guelph_or_ghibelline_trigger = yes }
				gg_first_and_second_are_opposite_sides_trigger = { FIRST = scope:attacker SECOND = scope:defender }
			}
		}
		scope:defender = {
			top_liege = this
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:attacker = { is_ai = no } } # Already pre-filtered by the AI due to ai_only_against_neighbors = yes. any_neighboring_top_liege_realm_owner is expensive
				scope:attacker = {
					any_neighboring_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:defender }
				}
			}

			trigger_if = { # if unlocked without the perk, only target involved or interloper
				limit = {
					NOR = {
						scope:attacker = { has_perk = forced_vassalage_perk }
						scope:attacker = { ai_should_get_conqueror_bonuses = yes }
					}
					is_guelph_or_ghibelline_trigger = no
				}
				any_character_struggle = {
					involvement = involved
				}
			}

			NOR = { # Can't vassalize Military Orders or Heads of Faith
				any_held_title = {
					is_holy_order = yes
				}
				AND = {
					exists = faith.religious_head
					faith.religious_head = root
				}
			}
		}
	}

	cost = {
		piety = {
			value = 0
			add = common_cb_impious_piety_cost
		}
		prestige = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				desc = CB_SIZE_OF_TARGET_REALM_COST
				scope:defender = {
					every_sub_realm_county = {
						add = {
							value = 125
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = vassalization_cb_prestige_cost_mulitiplier

			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
			multiply = { value = 0.75 desc = ve_religious_cost_factor }
		}
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		OR = {
			scope:defender = {
				top_liege != this
			}
			scope:defender.primary_title.tier >= scope:attacker.primary_title.tier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = {
		on_declared_war = yes
		ve_record_vassalization_terms_effect = { PROFILE = religious REFUSAL_RISK = no }
	}

	on_invalidated_desc = msg_vassalization_war_invalidated_message

	on_invalidated = {}

	on_victory_desc = {
		desc = ve_religious_victory_desc
	}

	on_victory = {
		on_victory_aggressive_war_effect = yes

		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = swear_fealty
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = no
		}
		scope:defender = {
			change_liege = {
				liege = scope:attacker
				change = scope:change
			}
			resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		}
		ve_apply_vassalization_terms_effect = { TAX_LEVEL = 2 LEVY_LEVEL = 1 RELIGIOUS_PROTECTION = yes }

		# Prestige level progress for the attacker
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige_experience = {
				value = medium_prestige_value
			}
		}

		# Prestige loss for the defender
		scope:defender = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = medium_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
			#GG flips the loser from opposing side to Undecided
			if = {
				limit = {
					gg_first_and_second_are_opposite_sides_trigger = { FIRST = scope:attacker SECOND = scope:defender }
				}
				gg_swap_to_undecided_forced_effect = { USE_MODIFIERS = flag:yes }
			}	
		}

		# Allies on both sides get full prestige value for helping in the war, based on their war participation.
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker
			FAME_BASE = major_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}

		#Guelphs & Ghibellines: gain Involvement based on war contribution
		gg_involvement_cb_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:defender = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = vassalization_cb_white_peace_desc_defender
			}
			desc = vassalization_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}

	on_white_peace = {
		on_white_peace_effect = yes

		#EP2 accolade glory gain for doing ok against higher ranked enemy
		scope:defender = { accolade_defender_war_end_glory_gain_low_effect = yes }

		# Prestige loss for the attacker
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = minor_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}

		# Allies on both sides get full prestige value for helping in the war, based on their war participation.
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker # Not important as the scales are identical
			FAME_BASE = minor_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}

		#Guelphs & Ghibellines: gain Involvement based on war contribution
		gg_involvement_cb_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		desc = ve_religious_defeat_desc
	}

	on_defeat = {
		on_defeat_aggressive_war_effect = yes

		scope:defender = {
			#EP2 accolade glory gain for winning against higher ranked enemy
			accolade_defender_war_end_glory_gain_high_effect = yes
			# Prestige for Defender
			add_prestige_war_defender_effect = {
				PRESTIGE_VALUE = medium_prestige_value
			}
		}

		# Prestige loss for the attacker
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = {
				GOLD_VALUE = 2.25
			}
			add_prestige = {
				value = major_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}

		# Allies on both sides get full prestige value for helping in the war, based on their war participation.
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:defender
			FAME_BASE = major_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit

	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "ve_religious_war_name"
	war_name_base = "ve_religious_war_name_base"
	cb_name = "ve_religious_cb_name"
	interface_priority = 59

	ticking_war_score_targets_entire_realm = yes
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150
	attacker_ticking_warscore = 0
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8

	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500

	ai_score_mult = {
		value = 1

		add = common_cb_ai_score_mult_additive
		multiply = aggressive_cb_ai_score_mult
		multiply = vassalization_cb_ai_score_mult
		multiply = common_cb_ai_score_mult
		multiply = ve_religious_ai_weight
	}
